[LTIE.4.6.1] The fact is sent to every
upstream tier, which asserts it under its own
declaration of the schema ([LTIE.9.4]). Upstream tiers
treat the incoming fact as if emitted by an
adapter: they subject it to the same no-op
reassertion discipline (per
[LFAC]) and the same
retract-on-key-change semantics.
